# MH-04 — Check availability

**Business value:** 975

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a user

I want to check table availability for a given date, time and party size

So that I can decide whether to make a booking


<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

The check is public: no login is required

Given date, time and party size, the system answers based on the free seats and the table layout, e.g., with 6 free seats split over 3 tables of 2, a party of 6 is available, this detail should be made available (e.g.. 2 + 3 + 1 seats)

No alternative slots are suggested, user can just check a different slot.
